About our productivity tools

The percentage calculator handles discounts, increases and percentage change, the date calculator counts days and business days between dates, and the scientific calculator covers trigonometry, logarithms and graphing.

For deep work, pair the Pomodoro timer with the Kanban board, which saves your tasks in your browser with no account required.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need an account to save my Kanban tasks?

No. Tasks are saved to your browser's local storage, so they persist between visits on the same device without any sign-up.

Can I use these tools offline?

Yes. Once you've opened a tool it is cached by the site's service worker and keeps working without a connection.

Which keyboard shortcuts are available?

Press Ctrl+K (or ⌘K on a Mac) on any page to search and jump to a tool. Many tools add their own shortcuts, listed on the tool page.
